This collection features a variety of natural mineral and crystal specimens including a druzy quartz geode slice, blue lace agate slice, polished agate slices, and an amethyst cluster section. - Amethyst cluster section featuring purple crystal points surrounding a hollow center

Each specimen shows natural variation in color, size, and crystal formation typical of geological samples.
